svg.aria-label: Tracker wiring: LiPo through INA226 and IP5306 and the power switch to the 5 V bus; WT32-SC01 Plus with MIDI out, encoder, the UART link to the Teensy 4.1 and the PCF8575 with the buttons on its Debug connector; the Teensy holds the microSD card and the optional PSRAM on CS0; the Audio Shield Rev D on wires: I2S in and out, I2C and 3V3 from the Teensy, number to number.
